title: Fourier coefficient square sum bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube whose values all lie in $[-1,1]$. The sum, over all subsets $S$ of the coordinates, of the squares of the uniform Fourier coefficients of $f$ is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: f takes values in [-1,1] on the n-dimensional sign cube
